ideas.name: Euro STOXX Futures Auction Flow
ideas.claim: In Euro STOXX 50 futures, closing-auction price deviations were positively related to the share of agent trading in the auction.
ideas.quote: We regress the auction price deviation on the share of agent trading during the auction, the VIX on the respective trading day, the auction share in continuous trading, and the share of agent volume in trading volume in 15 minutes around the auction (results are presented in Table 13 in Appendix G).
ideas.mechanism: Closing-auction order flow and price deviation

rules.timeframe: Closing auction; in the sample, trading ended at 22:00 Central European time, not 17:30

ideas.claimed_result: A greater share of agent trading in the closing auction was associated with a greater absolute deviation between the auction price and the last continuous-trading price. The sample covered January 2010 to December 2018.
